title: Closeness after imperfect domestic rebuilding

captions.physics: Rebuilding schemes after an exposed mismatch
captions.energy: Waiting for ideals before present support

meaning: Your domestic support sustains closeness when rebuilding allows a sufficient present form instead of postponing available time together until the entire desired domestic image is realised.
text: The Tower in the physical position of Muladhara can appear through rebuilding a domestic method after an exposed mismatch. The Star in energy complicates it through an ideal future replacing available support. The Lovers in emotions want open acceptance. Another method can remain too distant. Both already saw a need for change, but a present option seems unworthy of the dream. Closeness supposedly receives suitable space only after the entire home finally becomes what was imagined for a good shared future.

For example, earlier sitting room arrangements prevented comfortable togetherness. Placement changes, but an evening together waits for an ideal new sofa although suitable armchairs exist already. **Acceptance can have a sufficient form before a dream is fully realised.** You can name present convenience and choose an available meeting. Rebuilding supports both instead of merely preserving a beautiful future picture for which the present supposedly has no permission to be warm, usable or worthy enough.

The difficulty is considering the temporary rejection of something better and again leaving connection without present expression. Distinguishing dream from available need offers more dependable support: both can coexist. Support grows through manageable use without promised final faultlessness or making every evening confirm the ideal readiness of the whole future home before simply being together.
